description: Next.js custom Document component (_document.tsx) that sets up server-side rendering, localization, theming, and embeds scripts and meta tags for the web application.

classes.name: MyDocument
classes.description: Custom Next.js Document class that manages initial props, localization, theming, and rendering of HTML structure.

methods.name: getInitialProps
methods.description: Fetches initial server-side properties, including locale and URL-based embed detection.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the HTML structure including head tags, scripts, and body with conditional styles and scripts based on embed mode and environment.
